prompt: Write a one-star review of Yellowstone from a driver whose schedule was disrupted by bison.
response:
**★☆☆☆☆ Worst Traffic Jam of My Life**

Let me tell you something they DON'T put on the brochure. I paid $35 to get into this place and planned a tight 6-hour loop to see the "sights" and make it to my hotel in Cody by dinner. Instead? I SAT IN MY CAR FOR FOUR HOURS because some bison decided to take a nap in the middle of the road.

No ranger came. No one did anything. We just... waited. For wildlife. That the park apparently doesn't manage AT ALL. I saw exactly zero of the "famous" geysers because by the time the herd finally moseyed off, it was practically dark. Missed my dinner reservation. Had to pay cancellation fees. 

Oh, and the one buffalo that walked past my car? Scratched it with its horn. Good luck getting Yellowstone to return your calls about that, by the way. Spoiler: they won't.

You want to see animals? Go to a zoo. At least there they have, I don't know, FENCES? ENCLOSURES? BASIC CONCEPTS OF TRAFFIC MANAGEMENT???

Never again. My GPS says I spent 4 hours and 17 minutes going 0.7 miles. Thanks for nothing, Yellowstone.
